extracted.intended_audience: journalists and institutional public information officers (press officers) who handle medical-journal press releases
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing and distributing press releases that comply with medical journal embargo practices, including what to include in the release, timing/coordination with journals, distribution channels, and permitted pre-publication activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embargo notice prominently displayed
rubrics_metrics.description: Press release should include an embargo notice prominently displayed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place a clear embargo statement at the top of the release (e.g., 'EMBARGOED UNTIL [DATE/TIME]'). Make the embargo status obvious so journalists immediately see restrictions on publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specify specific date and time with time zone
rubrics_metrics.description: Press release should specify the exact date and time (with time zone) when embargo lifts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Always include the time zone (e.g., ET, GMT) to avoid confusion across jurisdictions. Use a specific date/time rather than vague language like 'upon publication.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Use explicit 'EMBARGOED UNTIL [DATE/TIME]' wording at top
rubrics_metrics.description: Include the literal wording 'EMBARGOED UNTIL [DATE/TIME]' at the top of the release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This standard phrasing signals clearly that content is under embargo and shows the precise lift moment; include capitalization or other formatting to ensure visibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide DOI/citation of the journal article
rubrics_metrics.description: Press release should include the DOI of the journal article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a full citation and DOI so journalists can reference or link to the article when embargo lifts and to ensure accurate attribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include links to embargoed materials where appropriate
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide links to embargoed materials (e.g., full text, supplementary files) when appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Host or link materials in the journal's embargoed-access system or approved distribution channel so vetted reporters can access content during the embargo window without public disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: State author availability for interviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate author availability for interviews at the embargo time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List contact information and windows of availability so journalists can arrange interviews coincident with embargo lift; helps coordinated coverage and accurate reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclose conflicts of interest
rubrics_metrics.description: Include conflicts of interest disclosure in the press release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make relevant financial or other competing interests transparent in the release to support responsible reporting and context for the findings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adhere to journal-specific embargo times
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow the embargo time set by the journal for each article (journal sets embargo; PIOs do not override).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Different journals use different standard times (e.g., The Lancet: 6:30 PM US ET; NEJM: often Wednesday 5:00 PM ET; JAMA/BMJ: set per article). Always coordinate the release timing to match the journal's specified embargo.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribute via approved channels
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribute embargoed releases through approved channels (e.g., EurekAlert, Newswise) and only to vetted media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the journal's or institution's accepted distribution services and lists; limit pre-embargo distribution to media who agreed to embargo terms to maintain control and fairness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not post to social media before embargo lifts
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not tweet or post content from the embargoed material until the embargo has lifted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid posting 'spoilers' or releasing excerpts on social platforms prior to the embargo lift; prepare social media drafts but publish only at the embargo time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate with co-authors and institutions before release
rubrics_metrics.description: Coordinate timing and content with co-authors at other institutions and inform institutional communications early.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communicate embargo details and timing to all co-authors and their institutional PR teams in advance to prevent inadvertent breaches and to enable synchronized coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limit pre-embargo distribution to vetted media
rubrics_metrics.description: Restrict pre-publication access and distribution of embargoed materials to vetted media members who agreed to the embargo.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide access only to approved reporters under embargo agreements to create a 'level playing field' and minimize premature disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare all materials in advance for embargo lift
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure all supporting materials (text, multimedia, figures, supplementary) are prepared and ready to release at the embargo time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Have final copy, visuals, links, and embargoed files staged so coverage can go live immediately at the designated time without last-minute delays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make multimedia ready for embargo lift
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure multimedia (photos, illustrations, video) are finalized and queued for release at embargo lift.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multimedia should be embargoed alongside text and available to reporters at the embargo time to support complete stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare social media drafts for embargo time
rubrics_metrics.description: Draft social media posts in advance but do not publish until embargo lifts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Have approved social copy, hashtags, and assets ready to schedule or post at the embargo moment to coordinate institutional messaging with the article publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid spoilers on social media prior to embargo lift
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not reveal key findings or 'spoilers' on social media before the embargo is lifted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain restraint in pre-embargo communications and avoid teasing substantive results that would undermine the embargo's purpose.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate press release timing with journal publication
rubrics_metrics.description: Align press release timing explicitly with the journal's online publication moment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Match the release to the journal's publication schedule (many journals publish online at a specified time); verify the journal's exact lift time for the article and plan accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Permit reporters to read and prepare but not disclose
rubrics_metrics.description: Under embargo, reporters may read articles, discuss with authors and experts, draft reports, and prepare visuals — but must not disclose content publicly until embargo lifts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide vetted reporters with access to enable accurate, timely reporting while enforcing non-disclosure until the designated time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consequences for breaking embargo
rubrics_metrics.description: Breaking an embargo can result in loss of access, loss of media credentials, suspension of outlet, damaged reputation, and difficulty obtaining future access.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware that embargo breaches carry institutional penalties; maintain strict controls and agreements to protect future relations with journals.

rubrics_metrics.name: State embargo clearly at top (implicit compliance item 1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure the embargo is stated clearly at the top of the release so it is unambiguous to recipients.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This mirrors the explicit 'EMBARGOED UNTIL' recommendation; visibility at the top reduces accidental early publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specify time zone (implicit compliance item 2)
rubrics_metrics.description: Always indicate the time zone for the embargo lift to prevent cross-region confusion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include both local and international time references if the audience is global (e.g., ET and GMT).

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate with journal embargo time (implicit compliance item 3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Coordinate institutional release timing so it matches the journal's embargo time exactly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not unilaterally change the embargo moment; the journal's embargo setting governs when content can be published.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare to limit pre-embargo distribution (implicit compliance item 4)
rubrics_metrics.description: Limit pre-embargo distribution to vetted outlets and journalists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain controlled distribution lists and avoid broad or uncontrolled pre-release dissemination that could cause leaks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide DOI/citation in compliance checklist (implicit compliance item 6)
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure DOI/citation is present in the press materials to facilitate accurate sourcing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Including the DOI helps reporters link to the primary source when embargo lifts and supports transparency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure author availability at embargo time (implicit compliance item 7)
rubrics_metrics.description: Confirm that authors will be available to respond to media inquiries at the embargo lift.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Schedule authors for interviews or embargo-time commentary and provide clear contact details in the release.

rubrics_metrics.name: No social-media spoilers before embargo lift (implicit compliance item 10)
rubrics_metrics.description: Avoid releasing substantive findings or 'spoilers' on social channels prior to embargo lift.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Restrict teaser content and instruct institutional and author accounts not to post findings early.
